specs.title: Onboarding Flow Architecture
specs.content:
# Onboarding Flow Architecture

The onboarding workspace coordinates activation status, implementation tasks, and account metadata in one operational view.

## Goals

- Reduce handoff time between sales and implementation.
- Track launch blockers with explicit ownership.
- Keep artifact history visible from the project page.

## Data Model

Each project owns specs, tickets, and executions. Tickets can reference a spec when they are generated from a planning pass.

specs.title: Billing Health Signals
specs.content:
# Billing Health Signals

Billing health should highlight accounts with failed payments, unusual revenue movement, and upcoming renewal risk.

| Signal | Severity | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Failed payment streak | High | Finance Ops |
| Contract downgrade | Medium | Account Team |
| Incomplete invoice metadata | Low | Support Ops |

```ts
export type BillingSignal = 'failed-payment' | 'downgrade' | 'metadata-gap'
```

tickets.title: Build secure handoff checklist
tickets.description:
Create the checklist component used by implementation managers during the customer handoff.

Acceptance criteria:

- Display required activation steps.
- Persist checked items per project.
- Surface incomplete required items before launch.

tickets.title: Add launch readiness summary
tickets.description:
Add a compact readiness summary that groups open blockers by owner and priority.

The summary should be visible on the project detail page and link to the filtered ticket list.

tickets.title: Implement activity stream empty states
tickets.description: Create clear empty and loading states for the activity stream so new projects do not look broken before their first execution.

tickets.title: Model billing signal severity
tickets.description: Create the frontend types and visual treatment for high, medium, and low billing health signals.

tickets.title: Preserve migration decision notes
tickets.description: Render archived decision notes in read-only mode and keep links to historical executions available.
